name: WdDeleteCells
description: Specifies a range of cells to be deleted from a table in a delete cells action or the behavior of the remaining cells after the deletion has occurred.

constants.name: wdDeleteCellsShiftLeft
constants.description: Shift remaining cells left in the row where the deletion occurred after a cell or range of cells has been deleted.

constants.name: wdDeleteCellsShiftUp
constants.description: Shift remaining cells up in the column where the deletion occurred after a cell or range of cells has been deleted.

constants.name: wdDeleteCellsEntireRow
constants.description: Delete the entire row of cells from the table.

constants.name: wdDeleteCellsEntireColumn
constants.description: Delete the entire column of cells from the table.
